description: A bet in words to Arena instrument ids and the Kalshi ticker and side to buy: 'chiefs ml', 'mia +3.5', 'kc mia under 44.5 sunday'. Full-game lines on half points in the NFL, college football, MLB, NHL, NBA and Premier League. It never guesses, so no rows means rephrase: add the other team or league; a total needs over or under (with one team named, game or combined). Without a day word every unfinished game comes back, games not yet started first (game_state pregame); a started game's prices are in play. To hold what the words ask, buy kalshi[].buy_side on kalshi[].ticker, or pass instrument_id with instrument_side = query_side. Store instrument_id as given.
name: resolve_market
title: Resolve a bet in words
